div.head: IV As 7
div.ab: Et si quis prepositus hoc non fecerit (disperdat) nec inde curam habuerit (adhibeat), det regi centum uiginti solidos, si per uerum recitetur super eum, et etiam indecencia perferat, sicut dictum est (diximus). Et si thainus sit qui hoc faciat uel aliquis alius, sit hoc idem.

[De infringentibus ista statuta et eorum pœna.] Et si quis præpositus hoc non fecerit nec inde curam habuerit, det regi centum viginti solidos, si per verum recitetur super eum, et etiam indecentia perferat, sicut dictum est. Et si thainus sit qui hoc faciat vel aliquis alius, sit hoc idem.

And if any reeve will neither carry out nor show sufficient regard for this [ordinance], he shall give 120 shillings to the king if the accusation against him is substantiated, and suffer also such disgrace as has been ordained. And if it is a thegn or anyone else who acts thus, the same punishment shall be inflicted.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.

facere nolet aut disperdet nur Ein Begriff auch III Em 7, 1, aus ne do ne ymbe beo. — Statt 120 sol. setzt synonym minc oferhiernesse II As 25. — Das folgende steht wörtlich Agsächs. V 1, 2ff. Auch das Zitat (des Greatley-Beschlusses) entnahm der Thundersfielder Reichstag dem Exeterschen. — Die Worte sit⁵⁴ hoc idem fehlen wie K auch Hs. Rs, also den Leges London.

facere nolet aut disperdet is a single concept, also in III Em 7, 1, from ne do ne ymbe beo. — Instead of 120 sol., II As 25 has the synonymous minc oferhiernesse. — What follows stands word for word in Anglo-Saxon in V 1, 2ff. The quotation (of the Greatley decree) too was taken by the Thundersfield council from that of Exeter. — The words sit⁵⁴ hoc idem are lacking, as in K, also in MS Rs, i.e. the Leges London.
See II As. cap. 25; V As. cap. 1 § 2, § 3.
